title: report.json — backtest score report
description: The backtest score report, written to .verdict/backtest/<run>/report.json and echoed as the score envelope's data object: the same object, so one schema covers both. It grades each replayed PR's recorded findings against the bug lines the run's own SZZ candidate records, through the corpus matcher (+/-1 line, one finding per bug, text that names the defect kind). catch_rate is a match rate over blame-derived candidates, not a measured catch rate: a line a later fix deleted is a hypothesis about where a defect was, a deleted cleanup line beside the real bug is a candidate that was never defective, and an unmatched finding is not proven false.

prs.description: Replayed PRs whose recorded review was graded: the denominator of off_target_per_pr.

not_replayed.description: Mined candidates the run never scored (no resume row, or a row that recorded no review). Their bugs stay out of the denominators.

bugs.description: Ground-truth bug lines over the graded PRs: the denominator of catch_rate.

unclassified.description: Graded bugs whose kind matched no rule, so no finding can name the defect and their lines can only lower catch_rate.

catch_rate.description: matched / bugs, rounded to four decimals; null when no PR was graded.

off_target_per_pr.description: (reported - matched) / prs, rounded to four decimals; null when no PR was graded. An unmatched finding is off target, never proven false.

cost_per_review_usd.description: Priced spend over the priced reviews; null when no review reported a price. The mean of the priced reviews only.

spend.description: The priced spend: usd is the sum of the reported prices, null when none was priced, and a lower bound whenever unpriced_reviews is non-zero.

signals.description: One row per seed signal, fix first: the bugs a fix or a revert produced and how many a review named.

usd.description: Sum of the prices the graded reviews reported; null when none was priced, never zero.

priced_reviews.description: Graded reviews that reported a price.

unpriced_reviews.description: Graded reviews that reported none; non-zero makes usd a lower bound.

signal.description: One seed-signal row: bugs a fix or a revert introduced, and the matched count.
